body.message:
Thank you for your message.

Well noted on the details provided. We are pleased to confirm your booking from 17 June until 24 July as requested.

The payment of AED 9,435 can be handed over in cash by Ms. Ghazal. Once we receive the payment, we will issue an official receipt and send a copy to you via email.

Regarding the security deposit, I will send you the payment link shortly.

We have also taken note of your preference for an apartment with two bathrooms, in excellent condition, and as close as possible to the swimming pool. We are coordinating with the Al Zorah team and will share videos of the apartment with you as soon as they become available.

For the viewing and your other inquiries regarding guest relations, bed sheets, towels, and future stay options in Dubai, we are currently awaiting confirmation from the Al Zorah team. We will share the details with you as soon as we receive their response.

Thank you for your patience, and we look forward to assisting you further.
